REPLACE-CHECK

The transcript shows the check *passes today* with `-W error::DeprecationWarning` — all 13 tests passed, exit 0. Yet the second run (without that flag) clearly shows the 2 DeprecationWarnings are still being emitted. This means the check cannot discriminate between "warnings suppressed via pytest config" and "warnings eliminated at source." The current check would report green whether or not any work is done, because the warnings are already not *erroring* under the flag combination shown. A valid check needs to assert that `uv run pytest ... -q` (the default warning surface) emits `0 warnings` in its summary, not that `-W error` doesn't blow up.
